title: Q-SYS-FAILURE-REGISTRY: bootstrap failure registry including natural-language-to-code bridge failures
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every bootstrap run
**Done check:** grep:foundation/bootstrap_failures.py::def register
**Status:** closed

Every bootstrap failure becomes a registry row (stage, cause, fix attempted, probe); bridge failures from idea text to code are a named class. Filed at thread close; the executor works it in driver order.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 219.8 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
